name: Coffee Pub Cartographer
description: Shared drawing tools for tabletop groups: temporary multiplayer canvas sketches with shapes and stamps, a persistent party map that reveals the grid around a moving token, and GM tools for adding walls, doors and windows from a painted battlemap.
pitch: Plan together and map as you explore: sketch on the canvas for everyone, and let a party map draw itself as your token moves.

features.title: Shared canvas sketching
features.text: Temporary multiplayer drawings with shapes, stamps, colors and timed cleanup.

features.title: Auto-drawing party map
features.text: A persistent party map reveals the 5x5 grid area around a controlled token as it moves.

features.title: Resizable map window
features.text: Separate map view with Light, Dark and Glass Tool window themes; right-drag to pan, wheel to zoom.

features.title: Record controls
features.text: Press Record to reveal tiles around the token, Stop to halt while keeping the view.

features.title: Click-to-wall for GMs
features.text: Add walls, doors and windows to a scene by clicking them on a painted battlemap.

steps: Open the Party Map window from the mapping button in the Blacksmith menubar.
Choose Map this scene; recording starts and the map draws itself as the token moves.

gallery.title: A map that draws itself
gallery.text: Walk a token through a scene and the Party Map window fills in the squares it has seen, with the walls and doors around them. Record, Follow and View sit across the top, and Stop Recording keeps what you have.
gallery.caption: Map recording

gallery.title: Sketch it out together
gallery.text: Anyone can draw on the canvas in their own color: freehand, lines, boxes, ellipses and stamps. Everyone connected sees the strokes, and they are temporary, so planning does not clutter the scene.
gallery.caption: Canvas drawing

gallery.title: Find any map again
gallery.text: Recorded Maps lists every map you can see, grouped by scene, with the official map of a place first. Each map you may change has rename and delete buttons, and the list shows how far it has been mapped.
gallery.caption: Maps
